_meta.describes: Badge tokens earned from a single attribute at a given rating, per height, with all other attributes at the 25 floor.
_meta.why_it_matters: The native token function is additive across attributes, so summing the 21 rows for a build reproduces its exact token budget. Verified against 2,048 native vectors.
_meta.source: native probe (21 attributes x 75 ratings x 20 heights)

fields.slots: 6 values in discipline_order, allocator output for this degenerate single-attribute build

_meta.verification: Audited: 31,500 unique (height, attribute, rating) keys with no duplicates; all token/slot arrays are 6 long; and every row at the 25 floor contributes zero tokens. Additivity was confirmed by reproducing the token totals of all 2,048 mixed vectors in badges/slot_allocations.json.
